flags.summary: Wren's song at camp (camp/wren:song_1): the first new line the party picked, hope, grim or silly.
Wren's song at camp (camp/wren:song_2): the second new line the party picked, hope, grim or silly.
Wren's song at camp (camp/wren:song_3): the third new line the party picked, hope, grim or silly.
Wren sang the horned girl's song at camp with the verse the party finished (camp/wren:song_sing). Earns the hidden Encore achievement; the Blue Water Inn's night line reads it.

Someone looked under Ratatouille's (or Silvain's) eyelid at camp and found a marsh leech (camp/ratatoille:eye_found, camp/silvain:eye_found). Part three of three of the hidden The Man Who Fell from the Sky achievement.
Mister Quillon told the party about his rival in the crimson waistcoat (camp/kip:quillon_rivals).
